anchors.quote: For this synthetic calculation, sum the exact amounts of active entries and add the rate when present; an absent rate contributes zero. Separate output controls return the fixed choice payload (zero for Empty), an optional one-third, an absent option, a Fixed two-thirds choice, the product of two-thirds and three-quarters, and the sum of 101 and minus one money minor units.
